description_en: The apartment is located on the third floor of a 4-storey building in the Ali Demi area, near the main street. • Net area: 73.77 m² • Gross area: 86.17 m² • 1 living room together with the kitchen area • 1 bedroom with access to the balcony • Storage room • Balcony • Ample corridor for distributing the premises • 1 encased toilet with natural ventilation • 3rd floor out of 4 in total, insulated with hood system • Well-managed building built in 2011 without elevator • Restored apartment, air conditioning, parquet, washing machine, etc. • Suitable for family living or investment • For more information, please contact us! bot126230
